content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, the falls here tumble through a green pocket that feels a world away from the town."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, Datanla has a proper rush to it and a little adventure in the way down."},{"poi_id":"p60","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, Dalato sits close enough to the falls for a calm bite without losing the afternoon."},{"poi_id":"p135","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, the lake is the soft counterpoint to all that falling water, still and wide."},{"poi_id":"p17","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, the grilled rice paper here is the street snack worth saving room for."},{"poi_id":"p112","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"From what Tokek knows so far, the nem nướng rolls are the kind of dinner you eat with your hands and no regrets."}]}
From what Tokek knows so far, all the must-dos made it in — waterfalls, flowers, a wild house and a park. Not my island, but I've done my homework.
